messages:
vik: Saw a reproducible case in the pegasus-int8 canary: partial funcall then stream dropped final frame -> runtime retry -> duplicate side-effects in staging.

maria: ugh. paste a short trace?

vik: snippet:
```
chunk1: '{\"action\": \"call\", \"name\": \"provision_cluster\"'
chunk2: ', \"args\": {\"size\": 3}}'
chunk3: <lost EOS>
parser: EOFError
runtime: immediate retry -> second provision call
```

ashley: two low-risk paths: 1) deferred_retry: wait T ms after EOF before retrying (derive from chunk_gap p95) 2) parser emits partial_call flag when it sees action==call+name; suppress auto-retry if flag set.

eval-bot: canary plan: 6k streaming requests, inject tail-frame-drop at 0.7%; compare baseline, deferred-200ms, deferred-400ms, and flag-only. Metrics: duplicate_invokes/100k, parse_fail_rate, added_latency_p95.

infra-bot: telemetry: chunk_gap_ms p50=17 p95=110 p99=260 (pegasus-canary).

maria: start deferred=200ms (safe vs p95) plus parser flag. Owners: Ashley parser + fuzz, Vik runtime quiesce. I'll draft RFC and dashboard. Acceptance: reduce duplicates by >85% on injected loss, parse-fail regression <0.05%. :thumbsup:
